description: This file is the main index module for ts-node, exporting core types, constants, and functions related to configuring and creating a ts-node service, as well as internal setup for module resolution, source map support, and extension registration.

classes.name: TSError
classes.description: Custom error class for TypeScript compilation errors, including diagnostics and formatted messages.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Main interface representing a ts-node service instance capable of compiling, ignoring files, and providing type info.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a ts-node service globally, optionally with specific options or an existing service.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new ts-node service instance based on provided options.

methods.name: createFromPreloadedConfig
methods.description: Initializes a ts-node service from a preloaded configuration result.

methods.name: createIgnore
methods.description: Creates a function to determine if a filename should be ignored based on ignore patterns.

methods.name: registerExtensions
methods.description: Registers file extensions for module loading, supporting ts and js files.

methods.name: registerExtension
methods.description: Registers a specific file extension handler for node module loading.

methods.name: updateOutput
methods.description: Updates transpiled output with source maps embedded.

methods.name: updateSourceMap
methods.description: Modifies source map JSON to set correct file and source references.

methods.name: filterDiagnostics
methods.description: Filters TypeScript diagnostics based on ignore filters.

methods.name: getTokenAtPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the syntax token at a specific position in a source file.

methods.name: createEsmHooks
methods.description: Creates hooks for ECMAScript module loading in Node.js.
